subject: rt-op
title: RT.OP.------TR.
description: Chart on book p. 178 (SR(TRS)II-34). RT-OP (reality options) is the subject; TR (transformation) is the partner. From the subject: RE-ST (restructuralism) and ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics). From RE-ST: EXT-DYM (extended dynamics). From ACC-DY: LK-IMP (linkage implications) and AFI (affinity insight). From AFI: POL-DY (political dynamics). From POL-DY: INFO-CON (information convergence).
